name: Eden: Discovery
detailed_description:
EDEN: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic first-person extraction shooter where 20 players enter a dangerous wasteland, each armed with a primary and secondary weapon. Your goal is simple: loot and reach an extraction point before time runs out—or risk losing everything you carry. Players can scavenge gear from crates, defeat AI threats guarding valuable supplies, or take down rival players to claim their loot. If you’re killed, all your equipment drops, and your killer can pick it up. Multiple players can extract and win if they survive; in some matches, no one makes it out alive.

Key Features:

• High-Stakes Extraction

Gather gear from crates, fallen foes, or AI-guarded areas, then make it to the exfil point to secure your haul. Dying means you lose everything you’ve collected.

• In-Game Currency & Tournaments

Earn and spend in-game currency on gear or enter buy-in matches. Settle your score with 1v1 showdowns where you compete for loot or currency.

• Social Spaces

Between matches, return to a shared hub where you can relax, plan your next raid, and trade with other players. This space is persistent, keeping your prized gear on display.

• Future Creative Mode

Build your own maps and game modes for others to explore. Host custom matches where you control the rules, bringing new challenges and fun to the community.

• Multiple Paths to Victory

Survive the wasteland, escape on time, or challenge rivals 1v1. Whether you’re outsmarting AI threats or battling other players, every decision can lead to glory—or complete loss.

EDEN: Discovery blends tense firefights with meaningful risk and reward. It’s not just about shooting—it’s about planning your loadout, picking your battles, and deciding when to cut your losses. Welcome to a world where every match carries real consequences, and only the savviest competitors come out on top.

• Marketplace & Player Economy

Every item you find or craft holds real worth. Trade gear with others using the in-game currency, fueling a player-driven economy.

• PvPvE Gameplay

Face tense firefights against human players while dealing with AI adversaries guarding high-tier loot and strategic locations.

A Glimpse Into the Lore

The year is 2030, and rogue AI has sparked a devastating global conflict. In a last-ditch effort, the world’s best and brightest escape Earth on a spaceship named Eden. But the planet self-destructs sooner than expected, forcing these survivors to return prematurely, landing near the historic Tigris and Euphrates rivers—an area believed to be the Garden of Eden in ancient texts. Now, they must reclaim Earth from the ashes of World War III.

1. Main Lobby: Prepare your loadout, form squads, and plan your strategies before venturing out.

2. The Wasteland: Battle in intense 20-player matches, scavenge gear, and try to make it out alive.

3. The Metaverse: Own persistent real estate, socialize with others, and build custom maps in future creative modes.

Humanity’s survival hangs in the balance, and every raid is a new chance to gather resources and rewrite Earth’s destiny—right where civilization began.

short_description: Eden: Discovery is a post-apocalyptic extraction FPS for 20 players. Scavenge loot, battle AI and rivals, and escape with your gear—or lose it all. Use in-game currency, run tournaments, and trade in a creator-driven world where every choice carries real stakes.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 CPU or Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 CPU or Equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2080
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Processor: Apple M2 Pro

  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Processor: Apple M2 Max
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: In EDEN: Discovery, players engage in intense first-person combat with both human opponents and AI enemies. There is violence, including the act of killing other characters, but no explicit gore or graphic depictions of injuries. While there are no sexual acts or references to sexual assault in the game, certain drug-like items can be used to boost health or stamina, reflecting the harsh, post-apocalyptic setting.
